Implement [#736](https://github.com/ravencloak-org/Raven/issues/736) — DMCA inbox + two-stage counter-notice workflow (launch blocker). Branch from current `main`.

The previous agent hit a session limit before opening a PR. Their worktree was deleted; you're starting fresh on current `main`. Bash IS allowed; retry on transient failure.

## Required reading
- `gh issue view 736 -R ravencloak-org/Raven`
- `docs/plans/marketplace-mvp.md` §4 (admin DMCA endpoints) + §5 (Vue route) + §6 (DMCA inbox `dmca@ravencloak.org`)
- `docs/adr/0006-licence-and-moderation.md` (14-day counter-notice window)
- `docs/adr/0008-marketplace-discovery-and-operations.md` (`dmca_pending` status was added by #725's migration 00049)
- `internal/marketplace/takedowns.go` + `moderation.go` (consume; don't duplicate)
- `internal/middleware/raven_admin.go` (admin gate from #735; if not yet on main, use the same pattern from `internal/middleware/platform_admin.go` from #734)
- `internal/marketplace/derivative_notifier.go` IF on main from #735 (fire on DMCA auto-takedown); else add a TODO + structured-log fallback
- `CLAUDE.md`

## Scope

### Migration `migrations/000NN_marketplace_dmca.sql` (use next free number — check `ls migrations/`)
- Table `dmca_notices`:
  - `id UUID PK`, `target_kb_id UUID REFERENCES knowledge_bases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`,
  - `notice_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(notice_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192)`,
  - `claimant_email TEXT NOT NULL`, `claimant_name TEXT NOT NULL`,
  - `counter_notice_text TEXT NULL`, `counter_notice_submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL`,
  - `counter_notice_window_ends TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`,
  - `status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','counter_filed','resolved_take_down','resolved_keep_up','withdrawn'))`,
  - `resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL`, `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`.
- Index on `(status, counter_notice_window_ends)`.
- Squawk clean: `SET lock_timeout/statement_timeout`, no DROP on existing tables. Reversible.

### Service `internal/marketplace/dmca.go`
- `DMCAService.Submit(ctx, input DMCANoticeInput) (DMCANotice, error)` — atomic tx: flip target KB `kb_status='dmca_pending'`, insert notice row with `counter_notice_window_ends = now() + interval '14 days'`. Email publisher OUTSIDE tx (best-effort, logged).
- `DMCAService.SubmitCounterNotice(ctx, noticeID, text) error` — records counter-notice; status → `counter_filed`. KB stays `dmca_pending` until admin makes final decision.

### Sweep job `internal/jobs/marketplace_dmca_sweeper.go`
- Daily cron: for rows with `status='pending'` AND `counter_notice_window_ends < now()`:
  - Auto-resolve to `resolved_take_down`, flip KB `visibility='private'`, fire `Takedowns.Create(target_kb_id, 'dmca', notice_id)`.
  - Trigger derivative notifier (via OnTakedownCreated registry if available from #735).
- Register in `cmd/worker/main.go` alongside other scheduled jobs.

### Handlers + routes
- `POST /api/v1/admin/marketplace/dmca` (raven_admin gated) — body `{target_kb_id, notice_text, claimant_email, claimant_name}`. Errors: 401, 403, 404, 409 (KB already dmca_pending).
- `POST /api/v1/admin/marketplace/dmca/:notice_id/counter-notice` — body `{counter_notice_text}`. Admin records publisher's counter-notice (MVP simplification — admin acts on behalf of publisher; documented in PR body).

### Frontend
- `/admin/marketplace/dmca` route → `AdminDMCAView.vue` — list of DMCA notices with KB target, claimant, window countdown, counter-notice status. "Record DMCA Notice" form modal.
- Admin-only via `requiresPlatformAdmin` meta (matches #734/#735 pattern).

### Ops
- `docs/legal/dmca.md` — designated agent `dmca@ravencloak.org`, submitting a notice (17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3)), counter-notice rights, repeat-infringer policy reference.
- Footer link in frontend Marketplace pages pointing at `/legal/dmca` — keep it minimal.

### Tests
- POST DMCA happy path + 401/403/404/409.
- Sweep: insert past-due notice → run sweep → KB private, takedown row exists, notifier fired (mock).
- Counter-notice: records text, sweep does NOT auto-resolve afterwards.
- Migration round-trip.
- Frontend Playwright happy-path.

## Pre-PR review (mandatory)
Read `/Users/jobinlawrance/.claude/skills/thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review/SKILL.md`. Watch for:
- 4 side-effects on POST DMCA must be ONE atomic transaction. Email outside.
- `dmca_pending → private` transition enforced by sweeper or counter-notice path, not by ad-hoc checks.
- Derivative notifier consumed via #735's registry if present; if not, log + TODO.
- main.go bloat — keep wire-up tight.

## Workflow
1. Branch `feat/issue-736-dmca-workflow` from `main`.
2. Implement → backend tests + lint clean; frontend typecheck + lint + Playwright green.
3. Thermo-nuclear self-review. Fix. Document.
4. Signed-off commit. NO Co-Authored-By. Title: `feat(marketplace): DMCA inbox + two-stage counter-notice workflow (#736)`.
5. Push, `gh pr create` (Closes #736, link ADR-0006 + plan §4/§5/§6, **note this is a launch blocker per ADR-0006**, labels `area/marketplace` `backend` `frontend` `legal`, milestone `Marketplace MVP`).
6. `gh pr merge <PR> --auto --squash`.

## Constraints
- Migration number: check `ls migrations/` and use next free (probably 00056+).
- Sign-off + hooks pass.

Report under 200 words: PR URL, migration number, files touched, test/lint/self-review summary, surprises.

content.text:
**Same pattern for all 5: rebase + resolve conflicts on `cmd/api/main.go` and migrations.** Concrete what-needs-to-be-done list:

### 1. Rebase + ship the 5 stuck marketplace PRs (~30–60 min each)

All 5 are blocked by the same pattern: main moved forward (4 marketplace PRs already merged + unrelated work landed), so each needs a fresh rebase. Conflicts will land in `cmd/api/main.go` and `migrations/migrations_test.go` (same shape we resolved on #763/#764 earlier).

| PR | Issue | Likely conflict surface |
|---|---|---|
| #789 | re-import (#730) | `main.go` wire-up, `migrations_test.go` sub-test |
| #790 | unpublish (#727) | `main.go`, migration 00051 vs main's 00055 |
| #791 | listing/preview HTTP (#731) | `main.go` route group, slug-hold dep |
| #794 | import (#729) | `main.go`, `migrations_test.go`, big projection diff |
| #795 | ops runbook (#737) | docs-only, should be the easiest — just `migrations_test.go` if any |

**Recommended order:** #795 first (docs-only, quickest), then #790 (smallest backend), then #791, #789, #794.

### 2. Marketplace launch infrastructure (post-merge)

- **Build + deploy fresh API binary** to demo box: `CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o /tmp/raven-api ./cmd/api` → `scp` to Vultr → `docker cp` into `ec2-go-api-1` → `docker restart`. Same pattern as the worker hot-patch we did for #767.
- **Build + deploy fresh frontend bundle** for the marketplace UI.
- **Provision `raven.ravencloak.org/marketplace`** — the SPA catch-all may already cover it; verify in Cloudflare. (Same kind of fix we discussed for `docs.raven.ravencloak.org` DNS.)
- **Provision `dmca@ravencloak.org`** — Google Workspace alias → admin distribution list. **Launch blocker** per ADR-0006.
- **Provision the OpenObserve dashboard** from #795 (deploy `deploy/observability/dashboards/marketplace.json`).

### 3. Smoke test in production

End-to-end: create a Public KB via publish endpoint → see it in `/marketplace` → import as a different user → re-import → unpublish → verify 410 on the URL → file a report → admin approve → verify takedown + strike increment + derivative notification.

### 4. Open follow-up (deferred, not blocking launch)

- **Entity-extraction work on Raven retrieval** — was previously "maybe worth lifting from mem0," but the 200-essay benchmark settled it: don't. Raven hybrid at 70% is already strong; mem0 at 2% confirmed they don't have indexing tech to steal. Leave it.
- **Per-plan quotas** (publish count, import count, storage caps) — deferred per ADR-0008.
- **Versioned publications** (`marketplace_publications` table) — deferred per ADR-0003 until a real curator persona shows up.

### What I'd recommend doing right now

Start with **#1**, in the order above. Want me to fire off the rebase for #795 first (lowest risk, gets one off the queue) and then tackle the next?
